zara-muse.alt: A painting in thick palette knife strokes of a woman in profile, seen from behind, with long dark hair and bare shoulders against a deep blue background.

konn-artiss.alt: A square artwork in collage and paint. A large glossy black disc with the name Konn Artiss in white capital letters sits over a collage of torn printed paper and thick strokes of yellow, red, black and pale peach paint.

banksy.alt: A dark statue seen from below against a grey sky: a man in a suit strides off the edge of a stone plinth while a large flag he holds blows back over his face, with scaffolded buildings behind.
banksy.caption: Statue by Banksy in Waterloo Place, London, installed in April 2026. Photographed in May 2026. Photo: Bex Walton, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

yayoi-kusama.alt: Close view of Yayoi Kusama's face, with dark hair, red lipstick and pale pink glasses in a decorative silver frame.
yayoi-kusama.caption: Yayoi Kusama, around 2004. A still from George Quasha's film series art is (Speaking Portraits). Photo: George Quasha, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

el-anatsui.alt: A weathered grey stone sculpture of a crouching, rounded figure whose large hands cover its face, set on paving in front of a yellow concrete building.
el-anatsui.caption: Ambivalent Hold, from a design by El Anatsui, made by the SKEP art collective for the Physical Sciences building at the University of Nigeria, Nsukka. Photographed in 2024. Photo: Mercyjamb123, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

s-h-raza.alt: S.H. Raza, an elderly man with white hair and glasses in a pale suit, seated and leaning over a sheet of paper as people gather close around him.
s-h-raza.caption: S.H. Raza at an art summit in Delhi, January 2011. Photo: Chetan Nikam, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

gerhard-richter.alt: Portrait of Gerhard Richter, an older man with white hair, a short white beard and round dark glasses, in a dark coat, looking at the camera.
gerhard-richter.caption: Gerhard Richter at the National Gallery, Prague, in April 2017. Photo: Jindřich Nosek (NoJin), CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

vhils.alt: A large portrait of a man in a cap, made by chipping away the pale plaster of a tall brown city wall to show the darker layers beneath.
vhils.caption: Joe Hatchiban, a wall portrait carved by Vhils (Alexandre Farto) in Berlin in 2011. Photographed in 2013. Photo: OTFW, Berlin, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

osgemeos.alt: A long, brightly coloured mural of yellow-skinned figures in patterned clothes, a giant sleeping face, floating trees and railway tracks running across an orange desert under a purple sky.
osgemeos.caption: Mural by OSGEMEOS at the entrance to the Museu de Arte Moderna in Ibirapuera Park, São Paulo, photographed in March 2011. Photo: André Deak for Arte Fora do Museu, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

faith-xlvii.alt: A tall painted figure in a dark hooded robe, face lifted and lit from one side, fills the pale green end wall of a block of flats. Bare trees stand in front and ivy climbs the brick beside it.
faith-xlvii.caption: Mural by Faith XLVII on the end wall of a block of flats in Cologne, photographed in February 2015. Photo: Raimond Spekking, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

andy-warhol.alt: A black and white photograph of Andy Warhol, with pale swept hair and round glasses, wearing a dark suit and striped tie, hands folded, standing in a formal room lit by candles.
andy-warhol.caption: Andy Warhol at a White House reception for artists in the inaugural portfolio, 14 June 1977. Photo: Jack Kightlinger, White House, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

pablo-picasso.alt: A black and white photograph of the young Pablo Picasso in a heavy overcoat, his dark hair falling over his forehead, looking straight at the camera.
pablo-picasso.caption: Pablo Picasso in 1908. Photographer unknown, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

jean-michel-basquiat.alt: A black and white photograph of Jean-Michel Basquiat smiling broadly, in a dark jacket over a pale shirt.
jean-michel-basquiat.caption: Jean-Michel Basquiat in New York, 15 September 1984. Photo: Galerie Bruno Bischofberger, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

keith-haring.alt: Keith Haring in a white T-shirt, holding a paper cup in one hand and painting a thick black line on a white wall with the other.
keith-haring.caption: Keith Haring at work in the Stedelijk Museum, Amsterdam, 14 March 1986. Photo: Rob Bogaerts / Anefo, Nationaal Archief, CC0, via Wikimedia Commons.

david-hockney.alt: David Hockney in a flat cap and round black glasses, wearing a striped cardigan, looking towards the camera.
david-hockney.caption: David Hockney in 2017. Photo: Connaissance des Arts, CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

damien-hirst.alt: Damien Hirst in a white jacket and red T-shirt standing in a gallery in front of a wall painted with large coloured spots.
damien-hirst.caption: Damien Hirst at The Complete Spot Paintings 1986 to 2011, Gagosian Gallery, New York, 11 January 2012. Photo: Andrew Russeth, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

david-shrigley.alt: David Shrigley in a dark top, looking to one side, in front of a flip chart covered in his line drawings.
david-shrigley.caption: David Shrigley in 2011. Photo: Andy Miah, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

ben-eine.alt: The end wall of a city building painted black and covered in stacked, striped capital letters in pink, yellow, green and blue, spelling LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT.
ben-eine.caption: LOVE AT FIRST SIGHT by Ben Eine, Zürich, August 2023. Photo: Balise42, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

jr.alt: JR in a black hat and dark glasses at the César awards in Paris, February 2020.
jr.caption: JR at the César awards, February 2020. Photo: Georges Biard, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

takashi-murakami.alt: Takashi Murakami in a dark jacket and glasses, seated on a tall stool at a small table on a stage.
takashi-murakami.caption: Takashi Murakami at GEISAI#10, Tokyo, 17 September 2006. Photo: Yamashita Yohei, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

ai-weiwei.alt: Ai Weiwei, grey-bearded, in a blue-grey shirt, seated in front of a purple stage curtain.
ai-weiwei.caption: Ai Weiwei at Fronteiras do Pensamento, São Paulo, 10 October 2018. Photo: Greg Salibian, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

william-kentridge.alt: William Kentridge, white-haired, in a white open-necked shirt, smiling slightly.
william-kentridge.caption: William Kentridge in 2025. Photo: Mozamaniac, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

mai-trung-thu.alt: Black and white photograph of the young Mai Trung Thứ standing beside his father, an older man with a white beard.
mai-trung-thu.caption: Mai Trung Thứ with his father, Mai Trung Cát, before 1945. Photographer unknown, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

frida-kahlo.alt: Black and white photograph of Frida Kahlo in a long skirt, seated on rocky ground beside a large agave plant.
frida-kahlo.caption: Frida Kahlo photographed by Toni Frissell in 1937. Library of Congress, public domain, via Wikimedia Commons.

mona-hatoum.alt: Mona Hatoum, with dark curly hair and glasses, in a striped top, seen in front of shelves of files.
mona-hatoum.caption: Mona Hatoum in April 2021. Photo: Miguel Lorenzo, IVAM, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.

zanele-muholi.alt: Zanele Muholi, in a dark hat and patterned top, speaking in a gallery while people with cameras listen.
zanele-muholi.caption: Zanele Muholi, left, at the Side by Side LGBT Film Festival, 22 October 2011. Photo: Side by Side LGBT Film Festival, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons.
